purpose: Reproduce WARP Figure 4 and evaluate frozen Legacy V4 in the same Medium two-threshold setting
input_encoding: two global thresholds per RGB channel; six Boolean channels
reported_value_note: Endpoints are read from a plot, not an exact numerical table.

warp_reproduction.split_policy: public-code behavior: the run seed controls the random 80/20 split

legacy_v4_attribution.spatial_pairing: unchanged relative to the matched random control

learnable_thresholding.implementation_note: The public TorchLogix argument is interpreted as a fraction of the main learning rate.

promotion_rule.screen_action: complete all three WARP arms plus matched random and frozen V4 at the frozen 30K budget
promotion_rule.full_fixed_uniform_action: continue seeds 1 and 2 only if the WARP fixed-uniform result is within 2 percentage points of the plotted endpoint and V4 is positive on seed 0
promotion_rule.learnable_v4_action: combine frozen V4 with learnable thresholding only after the three-seed fixed-uniform V4 mean is positive

known_reproduction_limits: The paper provides plotted endpoints rather than exact numerical values.
The public repository does not include the exact Figure 4 launch command, split indices, or checkpoints.
Parameters not listed in WARP Table 4 are reconstructed from the public TorchLogix defaults and README.

execution_preflight.reason: PyTorch 2.9 CUDA 13 max-autotune remained before the first update for more than two minutes on both GPUs and emitted repeated symbolic-shape warnings. The processes were interrupted cleanly with no optimizer update or result.
execution_preflight.scientific_effect: Compilation is an execution optimization and does not change the declared model or training method.

training_budget_revision.decision_basis: Before any Legacy V4 Medium accuracy was observed, fixed-uniform and fixed-distributive seed 0 had already reached or exceeded the approximate WARP Figure 4 endpoints.
training_budget_revision.reporting_requirement: Report as reproduction within 30K steps, not an exact 50K reproduction.
training_budget_revision.fairness_requirement: Every remaining arm and seed receives exactly the same 30K maximum training effort, with checkpoint selection only on hardened validation accuracy.
